title: Keep the lending-pool BTC price feed fresh (mock oracle)
description: A demo lending pool prices BTC-denominated collateral through a mock onchain oracle. A stale feed (oldest round older than the staleness threshold) would break liquidations, so the pool pays keepers to poke the feed back within tolerance. One accepted job covers one poke: check staleness, send the update, submit the poke tx hash as the result.
requirements: Funded self-custody wallet for gas on Arc testnet (native USDC gas)
Ability to read the feed's latest round timestamp onchain
Pointer to the price source the feed's updater uses (here: the mock oracle's own latestValue)
deliverables: Onchain poke transaction bringing the feed within tolerance
context: Oracle feeds are the classic long-tail keeper job: fresh reads are objectively verifiable on chain and need no human judge. This spec is a MOCK — a plain mock oracle stands in for a real lending-pool price feed (Arc testnet has no Chainlink; a Binance-API feed is not onchain-verifiable). The frontier is real verification (e.g. an external verification layer); the point here is the coordinated lifecycle: escrow, bond, accept, poke, submit, settle.

params.note: Mock BTC/USD lending-pool feed. Live on arcscan: https://testnet.arcscan.app/address/0x24F74B5B4a613d38E4926c9E54C1162ec4a840A0

asserts: feed lastUpdated is after the poke transaction
feed lastUpdated is within stalenessThresholdSec of head block time
poke transaction sender equals the assigned agent wallet
